description: LangChain helps connect steps in language-model applications. Learn its local runnable and prompt tools with small functions, without loading a model or calling a paid service. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain pass named values in a dictionary
Explain connect steps with a pipe
Explain run a batch of inputs
Explain use a prompt as a runnable
learningObjectives: Practise read text from a message
Practise keep input fields and add one

seo.title: LangChain Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn LangChain with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
